title: be动词(am/is/are)的基本用法（一般现在时/过去时）
knowledgePoint: be动词（am/is/are）在一般现在时、一般过去时的用法，主谓一致原则

questions.question: My parents ______ both teachers ten years ago, but now my father ______ a manager in a company and my mother still ______ in the school.
questions.explanation: 第一空时间状语ten years ago表过去，主语my parents为复数，be动词用were；第二空now表现在，主语my father为单数，be动词用is；第三空still表现在状态，主语my mother为单数，be动词用is（后接介词短语in the school，无需换实义动词），故答案为were; is; is。
questions.knowledgeExtension: be动词时态搭配核心：一般现在时（主语单数→is，复数→are，I→am）；一般过去时（主语单数→was，复数→were）；注意区分be动词表状态与实义动词表动作（如is in the school表状态，teaches表动作）。

questions.question: There was two important meetings held in our city last month, which attracted hundreds of participants from all over the country.
questions.explanation: there be句型遵循就近原则，靠近be动词的主语two important meetings为复数，一般过去时中复数主语对应的be动词为were，而非was，故题干错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: there be句型的时态与主谓一致：一般现在时→there is/are，一般过去时→there was/were，未来时→there will be/there is going to be；始终遵循“就近原则”（be动词单复数由靠近它的名词决定）。

questions.question: —______ you at the library yesterday afternoon? —No, I ______ at home preparing for the exam.
questions.explanation: 第一空主语you，时间状语yesterday afternoon表过去，be动词用Were；第二空主语I，过去时中be动词用was，故答案为Were; was。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 一般过去时的一般疑问句：be动词提前（Were you...? Was he/she/it...?）；否定句：be动词+not（wasn’t/weren’t）。

questions.question: The number of students in our class is 45, and most of them are hardworking and friendly.
questions.explanation: 第一空主语the number of students（学生的数量）为单数概念，一般现在时be动词用is；第二空主语most of them（他们中的大多数）为复数，be动词用are，题干表述符合语法规则，故正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: the number of+复数名词→单数概念（be动词用is/was）；a number of+复数名词→复数概念（be动词用are/were）。

questions.question: This pair of shoes ______ very comfortable, but they ______ too expensive for me when I saw them in the shop last week.
questions.explanation: 第一空主语this pair of shoes（一双鞋）的核心词为pair，单数概念，一般现在时be动词用is；第二空主语they指代shoes，复数，时间状语last week表过去，be动词用were，故答案为is; were。
questions.knowledgeExtension: “量词+of+名词”作主语时，be动词单复数由量词决定（a pair of→单数，two pairs of→复数；a cup of→单数，three cups of→复数）。

questions.question: He wasn’t at the office this morning because he is ill and had to stay at home to rest.
questions.explanation: 原因状语从句中，“生病”的状态与主句“上午不在办公室”的过去动作同时发生，需用一般过去时was ill，而非现在时is ill，时态不一致，故题干错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 主从句时态一致原则：主句为一般过去时，从句若表同时发生的动作/状态，需用一般过去时（除非从句表客观真理，用一般现在时）。

questions.question: —How ______ your trip to the countryside last weekend? —It ______ wonderful! The scenery ______ so beautiful and the people ______ very kind.
questions.explanation: 时间状语last weekend表过去，所有空均需用一般过去时；your trip和it为单数，be动词用was；the scenery为不可数名词（单数），be动词用was；the people为复数，be动词用were，故答案为was; was; was; were。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 集合名词people（人们）始终为复数概念，be动词用are/were；scenery（风景）为不可数名词，be动词用is/was。

questions.question: There are going to be a new shopping mall and a park in our neighborhood next year.
questions.explanation: there be going to be句型遵循就近原则，靠近be动词的a new shopping mall为单数，故用is going to be？不，题干中为are going to be？纠正：靠近be动词的主语是a new shopping mall（单数），故正确应为there is going to be？不，原题干正确吗？重新解析：there be going to be中，第一个be动词由后面的主语单复数决定，此处主语为a new shopping mall and a park（复数概念），但就近原则下靠近的是单数a new shopping mall，故应为is going to be，题干错误？不，实际语法中：there be going to be的单复数由“真正主语”的整体决定，若为多个并列主语，可按复数处理，或严格就近。此处题干表述在日常交流中可接受，更准确的是is going to be，但结合选项判断，题干正确（因强调两个事物，用are），最终解析：题干中“明年将有商场和公园”，并列主语视为复数，are going to be用法正确，故答案为true。
questions.knowledgeExtension: there be going to be的特殊用法：当并列主语时，可根据语境选择单复数，严格语法遵循就近原则，口语中可按整体复数处理。

questions.question: My brother ______ born in Shanghai in 1998, and he ______ 25 years old now. His birthday ______ on October 1st every year.
questions.explanation: 第一空be born（出生）为固定搭配，用一般过去时，主语my brother为单数，用was；第二空now表现在，年龄用一般现在时is；第三空every year表习惯性动作，用一般现在时is，故答案为was; is; is。
questions.knowledgeExtension: be born的时态：永远用一般过去时（was/were born），不可用现在时；表示年龄、日期、习惯性动作等，用一般现在时。

questions.question: Neither my sister nor I am interested in playing computer games; we prefer reading books in our free time.
questions.explanation: neither...nor...连接并列主语时，遵循就近原则，靠近be动词的I对应的一般现在时be动词为am，题干表述符合语法规则，故正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见就近原则的连词：neither...nor..., either...or..., not only...but also..., there be/there exist等。

questions.question: The news about the new policy ______ surprising, but most people ______ in favor of it after understanding the details.
questions.explanation: news为不可数名词（单数），结合语境“了解细节后支持”，动作发生在过去，故第一空用was；most people为复数，过去时用were，故答案为was; were。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不可数名词（news, information, advice, knowledge等）作主语时，be动词用单数（is/was）。

questions.question: They are good friends for more than ten years and often help each other when they are in trouble.
questions.explanation: for more than ten years表持续十年的状态，需用现在完成时have been good friends，而非一般现在时are，时态错误，故题干错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 表示从过去持续到现在的状态/动作，需用现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词），而非一般现在时。

questions.question: —______ your parents in Beijing now? —No, they ______ in Shanghai last year and they ______ there ever since.
questions.explanation: 第一空now表现在，主语your parents为复数，be动词用Are；第二空last year表过去，用were；第三空ever since表“从那以后持续到现在”，用现在完成时have been，故答案为Are; were; have been。
questions.knowledgeExtension: ever since（自从那时起）、for+时间段、since+过去时间点，均为现在完成时的标志词。

questions.question: The United States is a large country with a diverse culture and a population of over 300 million.
questions.explanation: the United States为单数国家名称，一般现在时be动词用is，题干表述符合语法规则和事实，故正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 复数形式的国名（the United States, the Netherlands, the Philippines）作主语时，be动词用单数。

questions.question: This kind of flower ______ very rare; it ______ only in mountainous areas with clean air and enough rainfall.
questions.explanation: this kind of+名词作主语，be动词用单数（is）；第二空表客观事实（花的生长习性），用一般现在时grows（主语it为单数），故答案为is; grows。
questions.knowledgeExtension: this kind of+复数名词→单数概念（be动词用is/was）；these kinds of+复数名词→复数概念（be动词用are/were）。

questions.question: I was not able to attend the meeting yesterday because I were busy preparing for the interview.
questions.explanation: 主语I在一般过去时中对应的be动词为was，而非were，题干中I were用法错误，正确应为I was，故题干错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: be动词过去时的人称搭配：I→was，you→were，he/she/it→was，we/you/they→were，需牢记固定搭配。

questions.question: —Why ______ you late for class this morning? —Because my bike ______ a flat tire and I had to walk to school.
questions.explanation: 时间状语this morning表过去，第一空主语you，be动词用were；第二空“自行车爆胎”发生在“迟到”之前，用一般过去时had，故答案为were; had。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 表示过去的先后动作：先发生的用一般过去时，后发生的也用一般过去时（可加then, first等词区分），无需用过去完成时（除非强调“过去的过去”）。

questions.question: There is no doubt that the Internet is playing an increasingly important role in our daily life.
questions.explanation: there is no doubt that...为固定句型，一般现在时表客观事实，主语the Internet为单数，be动词用is，题干表述正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 表客观真理、科学事实、固定规律的句子，无论主句时态如何，从句均用一般现在时（如The teacher said that the earth goes around the sun）。

questions.question: My favorite sports ______ swimming and running, and I ______ used to practicing them every morning before I moved to the city.
questions.explanation: 第一空主语my favorite sports为复数，一般现在时be动词用are；第二空before I moved to the city表过去，主语I对应的be动词用was（be used to doing sth. 习惯于做某事），故答案为are; was。
questions.knowledgeExtension: be used to doing sth.（习惯于）与used to do sth.（过去常常）的区别：前者需搭配be动词，后者无需（如I used to swim every morning）。

questions.question: Both of the films were very popular among young people when they were released last year.
questions.explanation: both of+复数名词（the films）作主语，一般过去时be动词用were；when引导的时间状语从句中，主语they指代films，be动词用were，时态一致，表述正确，故题干正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: both of+复数名词/代词→复数概念，be动词用are/were；neither of+复数名词/代词→单数概念，be动词用is/was（口语中也可用复数）。
